description: Which words reach this code? Given an O*NET element id (2.B.1.d), an O*NET-SOC or SOC code (13-1131.00, 13-1131), a CIP code (52.0201), an O*NET Technology Skills (Software Skills) category, a Tools Used UNSPSC commodity code or a Detailed Work Activity id, or an ESCO occupation or skill URI, answers the words that reach it, ranked by the catalog's use of each word under the code; each word's spread is shown as a label, never as a penalty. An ESCO URI is read back through the ESCO–O*NET crosswalk only. Every call, found or not, returns the step-by-step report of the ten stages it read, with the code's official links.

code.description: An O*NET element id, O*NET-SOC or SOC code, CIP code, O*NET layer code, or ESCO URI
